last.verdict: Investors cheered a third straight quarter of more customer visits and brushed off the margin dip.

reasons.label: Customer traffic keeps growing
reasons.text: Transactions rose 0.8%, a third straight gain, lifting comparable sales 2.1% versus about 1.5% expected.

reasons.label: Steady outlook
reasons.text: 2026 sales guidance held at low single digits; management pointed to roughly 2% comparable sales growth in Q4.

reasons.label: Lower profit margins
reasons.text: Restaurant margin fell to 23.3% from 24.5%; EPS of $0.27 missed the $0.29 estimate.

story: Sales turned around over 2026: comparable sales went from down 2.5% in late 2025 to up 0.5%, then 2.2%, then 2.1%. Margins keep shrinking on higher costs. The stock rose after the last three reports, as traffic recovered.
